notes: Phone calls: made for Mango Voice. Settings > Phone calls shows the full Mango webhook URL (with Mango's {CALLER_NUMBER}, {TIME_UTC} etc.). Each missed call becomes a task 'Missed phone call from (xxx) xxx-xxxx at 2:14 PM' for the person you choose, with caller ID and the line called in the notes. No patient matching. A repeated webhook for the same call is ignored.
